name: FDC-Ground: Improving GRPO for GUI Grounding via Exponential Rewards and Fact-Aligned Pruning
notes: The authors report 88.3% and 91.0% accuracy on ScreenSpot and ScreenSpot-v2 using 3.2K training samples and one epoch. They report a 1.18× training speedup and a 5.9% accuracy gain for FDC-Pruning over standard GRPO.
summary: FDC-Ground trains GUI element location models with a distance-based reward and completion pruning; a 7B model is evaluated on ScreenSpot and ScreenSpot-v2.
